tagline: Two homes in the hills, one warm welcome
heroNote: Family-run stays above Dehradun, where the valley wakes up before you do.
aboutTitle: Run by the same family for three generations
aboutBody: Birchwood Homestays began as one farmhouse my grandparents opened to travellers passing through the valley. Today we look after two properties on the same hillside, each a short walk from the other, both still run the way they always were — home-cooked meals, a fire in the evenings, and someone around who actually knows the trails.

We're not a hotel chain, and we don't pretend to be. If you stay with us, you'll likely meet the person who cooked your breakfast and the person who'll tell you which path to the waterfall is worth the climb.
footerNote: Built into the hillside, not just on it.
